correctness.rationale: The word parametrization, complete one-deletion output classification, and two independent shadow-packing upper bounds hold for all n>=2. value.rationale: The exact maximum of a natural fixed-composition deletion channel is determined for every block length, with a constructive optimal code and a matching graph-theoretic upper bound. The result is a useful precise benchmark for synchronization-error coding and improves on mere small-n census or generalized color-class bounds; it does not claim a new unrestricted code-capacity theorem.
